set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O02.6
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Operations engineer with local operator
Scope: Qualify engineering service/storage failures using local tested alerts and the separate H02.1 integrity/repair implementation; institutional routing stays O02.2.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O02 (bd-01M4W40K6BGH2A78J8820FP8M6)
Suggested delivery tranche: T3; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Inject disk exhaustion, database outage, stuck/expired work, terminated streams and restarted service; accepted state stays coherent and progress truthful.
2. Provide a bounded integrity scrub and a documented quarantine/repair path using a known-good backup; never rewrite accepted content silently.
3. Record alerts, resource recovery and operator actions; failure tests meet the declared environment's storage/durability boundary, with untested power-loss behavior stated.
4. Inject short writes/ENOSPC, permission failures, interruption before/after flush/blob install/catalog commit/response, and corrupted shared blobs; state the tested filesystem and do not equate process kill with physical power-loss qualification.

Verification: Fault matrix, source-bound logs and operator runbook rehearsal with exact retained-export checks.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O02.6/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/objects/src/main/scala/sanctity/objects/FileBlobStore.scala
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- H06.1: bd-01M4X8MB2G63FDYPV1DPX759X1
- O02.4: bd-01M4W5P8JRY7KB6KQJREBCXEAN
- O02.5: bd-01M4W5P8S8QAHG81H5TXFMVJVQ
- H02.1: bd-01M4X8MA2FP4M6X4A50CBSTPZ4

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: O02.6: Qualify service faults and operator integrity procedures
